family_reports.body: The family court system in Gwinnett County has caused my children and I irreparable harm. Theses bad actors have yet to be reprimanded for their actions. I am sharing because I would like the public to know what they did and for them to be brought to justice for violating my rights.

This system took a fit and loving father and used state machinery, financial pressure, false narratives, and incarceration threats to separate me from my son without ever giving me a fair chance to be heard. It has cost my family years we can never get back, and I want people to know that this can happen to good parents when custody courts stop looking for truth and start protecting the system (revenue generation).
The system that I naively trusted stole my daughter's life and my family's.

public_comments.comment_text: Biased and money hungry. Evaluation lasted over a year and a half. Changed opinion to avoid testifying and would not put in writing her recommendation and would only talk to the attorneys. Wanted temporary custody order and to involve many professionals before offering a final opinion. Seemed to want to drag matter on until financial exhausted forced a side to give on. Recommendation was entirely in conflict and opposition to test results.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Allegedly made the very statements that Kathryn Franklin would use against me in court to take custody of my kids away from me. Kim Oppenheimer never evaluated me nor produced a written report she gave me my full $3500 retainer back. Never cooperated with Dr. Eddie Beal who cleared me of all mental illnesses.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Conducted an incomplete and one-sided evaluation process that harmed my parental relationship without providing a meaningful written report or fair opportunity to challenge her conclusions.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Falsied records, misrepresented evidence, falsely accused me, ignored witnesses, ignored medical records, ignored therapist
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent
